queer_characters.name: Villanelle
queer_characters.notes: Explicitly romantically interested in women per source; her relationship with Eve is written as genuine mutual attraction, but she is killed off immediately after consummation, undercutting the representation.

queer_characters.name: Eve Polastri
queer_characters.notes: Source states her sexuality is deliberately ambiguous/undefined and left open to interpretation; 'questioning' reflects the text's open-ended framing rather than a stated label.
queer_characters.contest_notes: The source describes Eve's sexuality as ambiguous and intentionally undefined throughout the series; the showrunner frames the central dynamic as 'more complex than a romantic relationship,' leaving whether Eve is queer open to interpretation.

contributor_notes: Per source, Season 4 finale kills Villanelle right after she and Eve consummate their feelings, drawing significant 'bury your gays' backlash from critics who saw 'no real contextual reason' for the death. Source notes early seasons avoided queerbaiting through genuine mutual attraction. Villanelle's identity is tagged 'queer' rather than lesbian because the source only says she is 'romantically interested in women' without confirming exclusivity — a maintainer may wish to refine. No queer identity info is confirmed for any of the four showrunners in the provided source.
